title: Agent Workflow Decision
question: 固定 workflow 是否已出現需要 dynamic tool/next-action choice 的真實 decision barrier？
trigger: 多步工具選擇或 recovery 不能由 deterministic owner 直接決定
treatment: isolate one agent decision while deterministic owners keep transition authority
promotion_gate: Agent behavior must improve a real workflow without replacing mechanical owner truth.
